title: Vertebral fracture and amputation
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's vertebral fracture or amputation (only that code).

labels.vert_initial: Traumatic L1 fracture, new, active treatment
labels.vert_followup: Traumatic L1 fracture, routine follow-up while healing
labels.vert_osteoporotic: Osteoporosis with new vertebral fracture from a minor fall
labels.amputation_acute: Traumatic amputation of right lower leg, new

describe.vert_initial: After a fall from a ladder two days ago, imaging shows a closed wedge compression fracture of the first lumbar vertebra (L1); active treatment with a brace starts today. The patient has normal bone density.
describe.vert_followup: Routine follow-up eight weeks after a traumatic closed wedge compression fracture of L1 from a ladder fall; it is healing as expected (routine healing). The patient has normal bone density.
describe.vert_osteoporotic: A patient with known age-related osteoporosis has a new vertebral compression fracture after bending over to lift a laundry basket (minor strain that would not break a healthy bone); treatment starts today.
describe.amputation_acute: Admitted after a farm machinery accident with a complete traumatic amputation of the right lower leg between the knee and ankle; surgical revision done.
describe.amputation_status: The patient had a right below-knee amputation years ago and walks with a prosthesis; the stump is healthy.

note_rules.document: Write a hospital discharge summary with sections: Admission Date, Discharge Date, Reason for Admission, Hospital Course, Discharge Diagnoses, Discharge Medications, Follow-up. It is the inpatient record of this hospital stay, not an office note.

initial_for_subsequent.description: Used the initial-encounter 7th character (A) at a routine follow-up while the fracture heals.

subsequent_for_initial.description: Used the subsequent-encounter 7th character (D) for a new fracture under active treatment.

osteoporotic_coded_traumatic.description: Coded a traumatic fracture for a fracture from a minor fall in known osteoporosis (use M80).

missed_fracture.description: Coded osteoporosis without the current fracture.

acute_status_confused.description: Confused a new traumatic amputation with amputation status from the past.

rules.explain: Wedge compression fracture of L1, initial encounter for closed fracture: S32.010A (HCC 401).
refs: ICD-10-CM Tabular: S32, M80, S88, Z89

wrong.why: New fracture under active treatment: 7th character A.

rules.explain: Routine follow-up while the L1 fracture heals: 7th character D, S32.010D (no HCC).
refs: ICD-10-CM Tabular: S32, M80, S88, Z89

wrong.why: Active treatment is complete; this is routine healing follow-up.

rules.explain: Known osteoporosis + fracture from a minor strain = osteoporosis with current pathological fracture, vertebra, initial encounter: M80.08XA (HCC 401).
refs: ICD-10-CM Tabular: S32, M80, S88, Z89

wrong.why: A minor strain in known osteoporosis: M80, not an injury code.
There is a current fracture: M80, not M81.

rules.explain: Complete traumatic amputation of the right lower leg between knee and ankle, initial encounter: S88.111A (HCC 405).
refs: ICD-10-CM Tabular: S32, M80, S88, Z89

wrong.why: This is the new injury, not status after an old amputation.

rules.explain: Acquired absence of the right leg below the knee: Z89.511 (HCC 409).
refs: ICD-10-CM Tabular: S32, M80, S88, Z89

wrong.why: The amputation was years ago: use the status code.
